title: Localized section restriction and scalar tensor normalization
statement:
Let $a:\Lambda\to\Lambda'$ be a commutative condensed coefficient morphism, $T$ a scheme, $D_{a,T}$ its internal scalar extension and $V_{a,T}$ its exact restriction, and $B_{a,T}=Q(B^0_{a,T}[0])$ its restricted regular coefficient [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons]. Write $E_{R,T}$ for the exact section equivalence [def-pd-section-module-operations-data], $\bar E_{R,T}$ for its localization, and use the conjugate section tensor, unit and localization comparisons [def-pd-section-derived-tensor-data], [def-pd-section-derived-realization]. Given section scalar comparison data $s$ of [def-sfb-internal-section-scalar-pullback-comparison-data], define $\operatorname{sectionScalarRestriction}(a,T,s):V_{a,T}\bar E_{\Lambda,T}\simeq\bar E_{\Lambda',T}V^s_{a,T}$ by localizing its ordinary restriction comparison with the inverse and forward canonical composition factors (functor products here apply the left functor first). Define $\operatorname{sectionScalarTensor}(a,T)$ as $N\mapsto N\otimes^{\mathbf L}\bar E_{\Lambda,T}B_{a,T}$. Define $\operatorname{sectionScalarCoefficient}(a,T):\bar E_{\Lambda,T}B_{a,T}\simeq Q(E_{\Lambda,T}B^0_{a,T}[0])$ by the exact-equivalence localization factor followed by the single-complex comparison.

For an internal tensor normalization $t$ from [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons], define $\operatorname{SectionTensorNormalized}(a,T,s,t)$ to be the following predicate. There exists an ordinary natural isomorphism $o:e^s_{a,T}V^s_{a,T}\simeq(-\otimes E_{\Lambda,T}B^0_{a,T})$ that sends the sheafified scalar generator $z\otimes x$ to the specified local pure tensor $x\otimes z$ under the given ordinary extension-object identification, on every section and every module. There exists a natural isomorphism $e:D^s_{a,T}V^s_{a,T}\simeq\operatorname{sectionScalarTensor}(a,T)$ with two properties. On every termwise flat K-flat section complex $P$ [def-pc-kflat-complex], [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], $e_{QP}$ followed by tensoring with the section coefficient comparison, the section tensor localization map, and the canonical single-factor total-tensor comparison equals the restricted scalar computation map followed by the exact restriction localization comparison and the localized termwise ordinary map $o$. For every internal derived object $M$, the section image of $t.\mathrm{derived}_M$ followed by the fixed tensor comparison equals the localized restriction comparison at $D_{a,T}M$, followed by $V^s_{a,T}(s.\mathrm{derived}_M)$ and $e_{\bar E_{\Lambda,T}M}$. This defines the normalization predicate only; it asserts no existence or compatibility theorem. All objects are unbounded and uncompleted, with small pro-etale object universe $u+1$, morphism universe $u$, and section universe $u+1$.
